exclude.reason: the upstream-suite transpile pipeline's npm install (esbuild/vitest, 174 packages) — third-party tooling, not our syntax surface; gitignored for the same reason

machine-generated C (the embedded spike bundle, 23.5 MB) — byte-verified deterministically by the closures gate, which regenerates and diffs it; syntax-checking generated output only burns the check gate's entire timeout (measured: gov parse alone takes 62 s on this file)

byte-identical staged copy of the canonical runtime/spike closure — the closures gate verifies every copy in --check mode, so size/syntax judgment on the copy is double judgment of already-reviewed bytes

agent scratch of the parallel flywheel sessions (worktree-local, untracked, never shipped) — the code-size gate's file set is git ls-files --cached --others, so one session's deep-indented scratch turned the gate worktree-wide red for every other session (#352's recorded surprise: 8/8 violations under .zcode, zero in any reviewed diff; CI's clean tree was green throughout)
